title: Pdfly: pypdf has possible long runtimes/large memory usage for encrypted PDF files (CVE-2026-119208)
description: CVE-2026-119208 is a vulnerability in pdfly's pypdf component that allows an attacker to craft an encrypted PDF file with a manipulated page count (/Count) value. Accessing the page count in such a file can cause excessive runtimes and large memory usage. This issue affects versions 0.4.0 and later and has been fixed in pypdf version 6.21.3.
